scope: Current v4 and recorded inference variations; no new evaluation or training. Old checkpoints are not pooled into current scores.

frozen_protocol.expanded_calibration: Separate secondary pipeline: all11135 held-out-training crops, frozen4968 balanced validation pairs.
frozen_protocol.fusion: Fixed equal average of negative-validation-standardized ArcFace and MobileFace scores; separate recognition pipeline, unchanged reconstruction pixels.

mirrored_uncertainty.scope: Fixed-model/calibration anchor-ID resampling; shared negative identities, threshold fitting, training seeds, historical test reuse and upstream overlap are not fully accounted for.

protocol.pipeline: Native crop -> app min8/max256 handling -> x4 SR or bicubic -> round to8-bit RGB -> bicubic antialias resize112 -> same frozen MobileFace single/mirrored features.
protocol.unsupported: Reject min side<8, or resizing max256 makes min side<8, exactly as app. Retain every pair; report coverage and count abstentions as unsuccessful in all-pair success.
protocol.calibration: Original512 native crops from256 held-out official-training identities, original balanced512 pairs. Fit using supported calibration pairs only; report count. No test threshold fitting.
protocol.batching: Exact native shapes grouped for throughput; no padding/resizing to a batch shape. Recognition112 normalization only after exported SR.
protocol.scope: Recorded still-crop replay; not live camera/video or full-frame detector/tracker. Repeatedly evaluated cohorts; unknown upstream/FFHQ person overlap remains.

native_uncertainty.scope: Fixed model/native calibration, paired anchor-ID resampling only; does not fully account for shared negative IDs, calibration fitting, training seeds, repeated test use or upstream overlap.

native_runtime.scope: Warm batch1 replay. GPU wall timing synchronized. Browser fetch includes server upload handling, two comparison SR models, output PNG/base64 and JSON parse, excludes display rendering/capture/detection/tracking.

protocol.gpu_sr_core: Prepared tensor already on GPU; forward+clamp; synchronized host wall time. No decode/encode, transfer, recognizer or baseline-comparison inference.
protocol.gpu_full_crop_pipeline: CPU RGB tensor conversion and transfer, v4 SR,8bit rounding,112 resize, MobileFace single or mirrored features, embedding copied to CPU. Excludes camera capture, full-frame detection/tracking and image decode/encode.
protocol.http_app: Uncached /api/compare upload, no sample_id; includes loopback transport, server decode, both previous+selected SR comparisons, PNG output encoding and client JSON parsing. No recognition in this app endpoint; no capture/detector/tracker/rendering.
protocol.fps_scope: Reciprocal per-crop latency only, not measured camera/video FPS; no sustained full-stream or multi-face test.
